_meta.purpose: Gate 4 plan expectations, keyed by case_id. Joined onto the v2 golden datasets, which are never read for anything but case_id and question and are never modified.
_meta.scope: Gate 4 fields only: mode, direction, measure, top_n, benchmark, assumptions. Gate 3 owns metrics, dimensions, values, ambiguity and retrieval status, which live in the golden files and are evaluated by evaluate_v2.py.
_meta.finding: All 194 cases are descriptive retrieval questions. The set contains no ranking, trend, comparison, diagnostic or prescriptive question, so it cannot measure mode or ranking accuracy. What it does measure, and measures well, is that Gate 4 never fabricates ranking or benchmark structure on a plain question.
_meta.basis_verified_descriptive: Every question has the form show/total <measure> [for <value>] [<period>]. DESCRIPTIVE with no ranking and no benchmark is not a judgement call on these.
